why: The fraction is an arbitrary convention — nothing about summarising tells you it is a third rather than a half.
The answer follows from what condensing a passage is; the distractors are recognisably not summaries at all.
A piece of terminology, but 'controlling' transparently signals the governing idea and the distractors are eliminable by reasoning.
Follows directly from the purpose of condensation; no list to have memorised.
What makes a title apt follows from what a title is for — brevity plus accuracy.
A prescribed convention, but it follows from the precis reporting the passage objectively, and the remaining options are self-evidently wrong.
One-third of 450 is computed mechanically and regenerates with any word count; medium because the fraction it applies is itself a remembered rule.
Reasoning about why an under-length answer loses marks — it follows from what the word limit is measuring.
Negative form over properties that follow from what a precis is; adding new arguments visibly contradicts faithfulness.
Connected prose follows from a precis being a coherent restatement, though the ban on note form is partly conventional.
Direct-to-indirect speech is a stateable rule — pronoun shift, tense backshift, time-word shift — that applies to any sentence.
One-third of 240 computed from the stem; the same item regenerates with any number, though the fraction is remembered.
That the title sits above and is excluded from the counted limit is an arbitrary exam convention with no derivation path; labelled memorise under the tie-break.
Reading the whole before summarising follows from needing the central idea first; no recall involved.
Applies the controlling-idea concept to a described passage — reasoning, not recall.
Generalises the third-person conversion rule from singular to plural, which is exactly what understanding the rule buys you.
Dropping illustration follows from the purpose of condensation; derivable without memorising a list of exclusions.
Preserving proportion and sequence follows from what faithfulness to a passage means.
The live discrimination is rigid-versus-approximate, which is reasoning about the status of a rule of thumb, though it presupposes the remembered fraction.
Tense backshift in reported speech is a stateable rule that generalises to any verb.
